intentAndPurpose.intent: Circular toggle button carrying a max-2-character label (e.g. "Ag", "En", "12"). Toggle sibling of SingleTextButton. The unselected state is always a muted ghost; `attention` (high/medium/low) drives the selected-state prominence (bold/subtle/ghost-with-border). Supports `condensed`, `fullWidth`, `disabled`, and `loading` (busy, non-disabled). Controlled via `selected`/`onSelectedChange` or uncontrolled via `defaultSelected`.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label — max 2 characters (e.g. "Ag", "En", "A", "12"). Longer text breaks the circular shape and is truncated in dev with a warning.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state (the toggle pressed state).

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires with the next boolean selected state.

props.name: value
props.description: Value for a selection group (parity — passthrough for a future native ToggleGroup).

props.name: size
props.description: Button size. S/M/L only — no XS.

props.name: attention
props.description: Prominence of the SELECTED state: high→bold fill, medium→subtle fill, low→ghost with accent border. Unselected is always muted ghost.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent role. Explicit non-'auto' wins; otherwise resolves to 'primary'.

props.name: condensed
props.description: Reduces height/padding while keeping the same typography.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill container width — overrides the circular shape.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner replacing the label and marks the control busy. Activation is suppressed while busy, but it is NOT marked disabled.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label override — children text is visible so this is optional.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Describes the result of toggling (React Native).

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: [error] Don't paint directly. Use `appearance` (role) + `variant`/`mode` and wrap in <Surface mode>; the brand cascade picks the right fill.

props.name: style
props.description: Layout style only. attention + appearance + the parent <Surface> drive bg / text — do not paint here. — [warn] SelectableSingleTextButton colour is surface-resolved from `attention` + `appearance`. Don't set backgroundColor; wrap in <Surface> and it adapts automatically.
